title: Ceasefire
text: “I can’t let you guys go any further like this. It’s for your sake, and for Melromarc’s sake as well.”
“Wha… that’s ridiculous… Our god would never say such a thing…”
“Anyone who says something like that… isn’t a god! You impostor!”
“That’s right! This guy’s a fake!”
The Shusaku representative turns to look behind him, as if coming to his senses.
“Kill him! Anyone who says such things must be a demon masquerading as a god! We came here for a holy war—to destroy the hated Melromarc!”
“Everyone! Calm down! Calm down!”
But once the wheels have started turning, they won’t stop. A general beneath the Shusaku turned raised his hand high and, ignoring the commander’s order, cast Magic at my Father.
“Shooting Star Shield X! Keel, Luna, make sure you don’t leave my side, no matter what.”
“Got it.”
“B-big brother…”

Keel curled his tail like a frightened puppy and cowered behind his Father and Luna. And so, his Father was forced to block both the incoming Magic and the attacks from the Siltvelt Army with his shield in one fell swoop.
“Everyone! Keep your cool!”

At this point, the representatives of the Shusaku clan seemed to have realized the gravity of their actions, but the hotheads among them wouldn’t stop. After all, many Demi-Humans are naturally hot-blooded. It seems they had become enraged by the battle.
“Guh…”

The Defense Power of the “Shooting Star Shield X” that my father had cast was high, and it showed no signs of breaking, but he was outnumbered. Enduring the assault pointlessly would only serve to wear down his spirit. Furthermore, the Melromarc Army, which had been guarding the border behind my father and the Siltvelt Army, launched an attack from the rear.
“Annihilate the Demon of the Shield and the Siltvelt Army!”
“A pincer attack at a time like this… I knew it was coming… but now I’m not sure if this battle can be stopped.”
It seems my father had almost given up at that moment, realizing the war had reached a point where it could no longer be stopped.
“If only Motoyasu or Elena could make it in time…”
“Big brother…”
The Melromarc Army in the rear was preparing to cast Ceremonial Magic.
“Luna! Is there anything you can do to keep the people of Siltvelt from getting hurt?”
“I can.”
Luna began her Magic incantation.
“Luna, the Source of Power, commands: Interpret the truth once more, and let the darkness that sweeps them away be here.”
“Al-Dark-Blow”

A fist formed of darkness shoved the Demi-Humans and Beastmen swarming around my Father, forcing them out of the Ceremonial Magic’s range. As if in unison, the Siltvelt army also began chanting their Ceremonial Magic, aiming it at my Father. It was only to be expected that the high-Attack Power Beastmen would then launch an attack against him.
“How can we put an end to this battle with minimal casualties…”
“Both sides are raring to go, bro…”
Father clicked his tongue at Keel’s words. Yes, if it were simply a matter of defeating the enemy, Father, Keel, and Luna could handle this situation just fine.

But to minimize casualties as much as possible? Honestly, that’s an impossible task. If I’d been here, I could’ve nullified the Ceremonial Magic with “Absorb” and, to intimidate them, shown off something like “Liberation Firestorm X”—given how strong they are, that would’ve been enough to hold them off.
“Motoyasu…”
“So you’re counting on the guy with the spear to show up…? You’ve got your work cut out for you, bro.”
“I know. I… can only protect others, after all. I can’t attack like Motoyasu-kun, nor can I nullify Magic.”

My father said this as he absorbed the Magic that had been cast in frustration. I… when my father is seriously trying to protect someone, even though I myself couldn’t possibly hurt him, he really doesn’t need to push himself that hard. I’m not that strong, after all. All I need to do is fulfill my role as a hero and do what I’m capable of.

I really don’t want you to push yourself too hard. If this were my future father, how would he have stopped this fight? If we’re just talking combat, he’d probably cast “Meteor Wall,” an advanced version of “Shooting Star Shield,” right? Hmm… I haven’t the faintest idea.
“Take this! You fool who presumes to be a god!”
“I said stop!”
The Shusaku was trying to physically silence his subordinates, but they wouldn’t stop. Siltvelt’s chain of command was steeped in the will to attack. Just then!
“I am the source of power. I command you. Interpret the truth once more, O Great Plant. Pierce these fools!”
“Al-Drifa Spite Bamboo Spike!”
Giant bamboo shoots sprouted at the feet of the Siltvelt Army’s magic unit, blowing them away.
“Huh?”

Faced with a magical attack from an unexpected direction, the Siltvelt Army turned their gaze toward the caster. That caster approached as if to protect my Father and turned to face the Siltvelt Army.

“What’s going on with you lot?! Look at this situation! Not just the soldiers, but even the knights—they’re charging straight at the enemy like wild boars, shouting, ‘Defeat the one who usurps the name of God!’ Where have all those people gone who were so afraid that if they didn’t handle this calmly, they’d fall into the trap of the Wise King?”
Extending its claws, standing there as if to protect my Father was…
“Lars-chan!?”
Yes, it turns out she was a panda beastman.
“Oops… I still can’t stop the attack from Melromarc’s army. Sorry, but could you let me into your barrier?”
“Y-yeah!”
My father sent the formation function to the panda beastman.
“Follow the Father!”

The group that looked up to the Panda Beastman joined Father’s side. Father’s barrier feels a bit cramped now. With a crack, “Judgment” came crashing down toward Father and the others. Thanks to Father’s barrier, they’re unharmed.
“Seriously… I did think something was fishy. So you really were the Shield Hero after all.”
“You figured it out, didn’t you? Since you’ve been MIA lately, I thought you might be part of this expeditionary force…”
“Of course I did! What do you take me for?”
“A mercenary, right?”
“Th-that’s why I could smell the money coming your way…”
Apparently, the Panda Beastman let out a deep sigh.

“Mercenaries have to know a lot about combat, and they fight for money. And above all, they need the composure to know when to cut their losses. With a command structure this chaotic, it’s just like we’re in full retreat.”
“Yeah, even so… we have to stop this fight.”
“You’re something else, aren’t you? Anyway, I’ll go pour some water on them and tell them to calm down.”
The panda beastman shouted this at the Siltvelt army, which had taken damage from his attack.
“Hey, you lot—are you really saying that you’re the fake Shield Hero if you can pull off a stunt like surviving Ceremonial Magic unscathed?”
Seeing my father, who had remained unscathed by the “Judgment” that had just fallen, the murmurings among the Siltvelt army grew even louder.
“B-but! If Melromarc has no intention of backing down, we’ve got no choice but to fight!”

Just as he said that, a massive force arrived behind the Melromarc army. My father-in-law thought reinforcements had arrived, but it seems those reinforcements were actually there to subdue the Melromarc army. A battle broke out in the rear between the mysterious army and the Melromarc forces, leaving the Siltvelt army and my Father bewildered. Eventually, a detachment from the mysterious army approached my Father.
“Ah!”
It was said that the Lazy Pig and the Queen were coming toward my Father. Oh, the Lazy Pig speaks later on, but that’s because I heard it from my Father.
“I finally caught up.”
“Elena, did you make it in time?”
“That’s why I came. I went to tell the Queen that the Shield Hero had headed toward the border to protect Melromarc from Siltvelt’s advance.”
“It’s a pleasure to meet you, Shield Hero. I am Mirellia Q Melromarc, Queen of Melromarc. I look forward to working with you.”
“Ah, yes… I’m Naofumi Iwatani, the Shield Hero.”

The queen bowed and turned toward the Siltvelt army. It seems an elderly man of the Genmu race was accompanying her. The representative of the Shusaku race watched the scene and breathed a sigh of relief.
“It seems our battle is not a holy war after all. It appears we’ve fallen into the same trap as the rot of Melromarc.”
